summary: PR #42's Source patch in the review panel draws Compare's unified-patch gutter: old and new line-number columns and the added and removed tints, with no editor line numbers or folds of its own, at rest and with Find on its current match, in Midnight and Daylight at code 12 pt and 18 pt
limitations: Linux under XWayland at scale factor 1 only, window 1000x680, interface 13 pt with code 12 pt and 18 pt; the hunk-folded state does not apply (coordinator decision 2026-10-02: Compare's unified patch turns folding off); Source and Compare are compared by fill and per-column clearance measurements, not pixel by pixel, since a compare reads both frames at one position; Compare's patch has a ---/+++ header and three lines of leading context in its second hunk, so only the first hunk matches row for row; macOS, native Wayland, fractional scales, hover, scrolling, the accessibility tree and live GitHub are not covered

fixture.name: pr-source-gutter-like-compare
